answer: Bonded sponsorship with joint slash blocks fake identities. Every agent needs an established sponsor locking twice 30 days of earnings; no anonymous harbor forms since each identity carries a sponsor's stake. Honest agents work and unlock the bond after 24 epochs. A verified clone erodes the sponsor like water on karst: 30% of both bonds is slashed, sponsor barred 12 epochs. Cost: N identities locks N x 60 days of earnings; one fraud burns 30% of it, so even a juniper grove of clones loses money. Renting sponsors backfires: sponsors price above the slash risk.
